Question: What is credit?
Answer: Say you want to purchase or lease a car, but dont have enough money to pay for it all at once. Enter credit. Credit allows customers to take possession of something, in our case a vehicle, before it is fully paid. A financial institution extends credit for the item, on the expectation that payment will be completed in the future. With credit through Toyota Financial Services, you can either finance (make monthly payments on an amount borrowed to pay for the purchase) or lease (pay for the use of a vehicle for a set period of time plus any lease charges).

Question: What is your credit made of?
Answer:
There are a few factors that make up someones credit:
Credit Report
A credit report is issued by an independent credit reporting agency and includes personal information; credit information like accounts, dates opened, account numbers, terms, amounts borrowed and payment history; how many creditors have requested your credit report; and public records of tax liens, bankruptcies and court-awarded judgments.
Credit reports are generated by each of the three major credit-reporting bureaus: Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion. What is reflected in your credit report may be used to compute your credit score.
Credit Score
Your credit score, sometimes referred to as a FICO score, can range from 300-850. The higher it is, the better. Good credit scores can make it easier and cheaper to get credit for the things you want. Basically, the scores have become a way to see how an individuals credit compares to hundreds of thousands of other consumers, and are used by financial institutions to decide how likely you are to honor your financial commitments.
Actually, you have more than one credit score. Each of the three bureaus uses a different score for its own purposes, and theyre not all the same for each person. These scores will also fluctuate from time to time, and may differ based on how each bureau calculates scores based on its stated criteria. To keep your credit in good standing its important to be proactive.

Question: How can a late payment affect my credit score?
Answer: Missing a payment, or paying beyond your due date, can hurt your credit score. As a credit reporter to the Credit Reporting Agencies (CRAs), we are required, per the Fair Credit Reporting Act, to report your pay history accurately. If your payment is more than 30 days beyond your due date, we may report this to the CRAs, meaning the late payment could appear on your credit reports. A CRA generally can report most negative information for seven years. Payment history reported to the CRAs becomes part of your overall credit report. The CRAs use your credit history to develop a credit score. Your credit score is then used by creditors to make decisions surrounding whether to extend you credit. Even one late payment may have negative consequences to your credit score.

Question: What is Multi-Factor Authentication?
Answer: TFS uses multi-factor authentication (MFA) to help us verify your identity. MFA is an authentication method used to help prevent unauthorized access to your account by relying on two or more independent factors to verify your identity. With MFA in place, end users are required to supply two or more independent factors to verify your identity. For example, you may be asked to enter your password and a verification code. A verification code is a one-time use code that we send to you by email, text or phone call. For additional security, you may choose to receive a verification code each time you login. You may choose to add this two step verification process when you register your account or anytime from the Profile/Security settings within your account. Although this two step verification process is optional, we may still require a verification code at login in certain instances such as if your risk profile is high, based on your typical login and usage profile and/or you have indicated that you are sharing your device with others.

Question: What is the definition of total loss?

Covered Vehicle is declared a Total Loss by Your Physical Damage Insurer,
No Physical Damage Insurance exists and Covered Vehicle is stolen and not recovered within thirty (30) days after the date of theft and remains unrecovered at the time of notification of Total Loss to the Program Administrator, or
No Physical Damage Insurance exists and the total cost to repair Covered Vehicle is greater than or equal to its Cash Value as determined by the Program Administrator using the average retail value for a used vehicle in the NADA Official Guide applicable to Your Unit Type, or its equivalent, based on the best information available on Covered Vehicle’s options, age, and condition.

Question: How is the cash value calculated for my vehicle in the event of a total loss GAP claim?
Answer: Cash Value 2 means the value of the Vehicle on the Date of Total Loss , prior to its physical damage or theft, as determined by Your Physical Damage Insurer, plus any amount subtracted from that value due to pre-existing damage to Covered Vehicle, condition adjustments, and/or the following items if subtracted from the settlement amount: storage charges, towing, recovery fees, salvage payments, and/or other fees and deductions; less Your Physical Damage Insurance deductible up to 1,000, if applicable. If You do not have Physical Damage Insurance or Your Physical Damage Insurance has either a stated value or a limit of liability that is less than the value of Covered Vehicle on the Date of Total Loss , or does not cover the Total Loss, the Cash Value 2 is determined by the Program Administrator using the average retail value for a used vehicle in the National Automobile Dealers Association (NADA) Official Guide applicable to Your Unit Type, or its equivalent, based on the best information available on Covered Vehicles options, age, and condition as of the Date of Total Loss , less Your Physical Damage Insurance deductible up to  1,000, if applicable. If We show You that the Physical Damage Insurer failed to pay a fair actual cash value for Covered Vehicle , as determined by the Program Administrator using NADA value or its equivalent at the Date of Total Loss , You may be required to contact the Physical Damage Insurer to request a higher actual cash value and payment. 2. The information provided varies by state. Please see your GAP agreement, certificate, waiver, or selling dealer for complete details.

Question: Where will the title/lien release be sent?
Answer:
We’ll mail the title/lien release to your primary address on file, unless instructed otherwise.  Your primary address is either the garage address for the vehicle or your mailing address, if you provided a separate address to receive TFS correspondence.
We’ll notify the state of the lien release, and they’ll typically mail the title to the registered owner’s address unless instructed otherwise.
Exception: Florida and Arizona generally require the title to remain electronic unless the owner requests a paper title).

Question: How can I update my title/lien release delivery address?
Answer:
If payoff funds are sent via mail, you may include written instructions with the payoff funds.
After you have paid off, if you need to update the delivery address, please contact us at (800) 874-8822.
Written or verbal authorization is required for the title/lien release to be sent to a third party (e.g., dealer, insurance company, another financial institution or individual third party).  Please include your written authorization with the mailed payoff funds or contact us at (800) 874-8822.

Question: What should I do if I paid off my loan but have not received my title/lien release?
Answer:
If it has been more than 40 business days since your payoff was posted, please contact us at (800) 874-8822.
If it has been more than 9.5 weeks since your payoff was posted, contact your local state titling agency.

Question: How will the new website and payment experience impact my payments?
Answer: When you log in to your account after November 12, 2023, you will see upgrades to the website and payment experience. Recurring Payments: If you had recurring payments set up prior to November 12, 2023, they will continue to process with the bank account information you submitted when the payment was set up, and you do not need to take any action. If you need to cancel this recurring payment, you can do so when you log in to your account and view your transactions. If you are looking to edit or modify your recurring payment, you can do so by cancelling and setting up a new recurring payment. Scheduled One Time Payments: If you set up a scheduled one-time payment prior to November 12, 2023, it will continue to process with the bank account information you submitted when the payment was set up, and you do not need to take any action. If you need to cancel this scheduled payment, you can do so when you log in to your account and view your transactions. If you are looking to edit or modify your scheduled one-time payment, you can do so by cancelling and setting up a new payment. Payments made or scheduled on the website after November 12, 2023 will now appear on your bank statement as Toyota ACH rather than Web Payment  Toyota Financial.

Question: How will the new website and payment experience impact my saved bank accounts?
Answer: As we transition to the new payment experience, you may be asked to add your bank account information again when you set up a future payment. Once you add and save this information, you can access it for future use. If you have recently made a payment on the mobile app or via phone, you may see the bank account information used for that transaction reflected as a payment option. As always, youll want to ensure that you review and confirm the details of the bank account you are selecting prior to submitting any payment.

Question: What is the difference between Pay Online and the AutoCheque program?
Answer: Pay Online is a flexible and convenient electronic payment method that allows you to schedule, view, update, or cancel payments, and check the payment processing status on our website. Customers can also schedule one-time payments and set up Recurring Payment Profiles. You enrolled in Pay Online when you registered on to the website. To make payments or view website payment details, you need to add a bank account. The AutoCheque program offers the convenience of automatically debiting your bank each month. To get started, download the [AutoCheque Enrollment Authorization Form](/content/dam/tmcc-webcommons/toyotafinancial/documents/planning_tools/ways_to_pay/TFS_Auto_Cheque_Form.pdf) and follow the instructions in the form (Note: To access this form, you need to install the free [Adobe Acrobat Reader DC](https://get.adobe.com/reader/) onto your computer). After receiving your completed and signed form, we will process your enrollment request. Enrollment is generally completed within 14 business days.

Question: How do I set up a one-time or recurring payment?
Answer:
Log in to the website
Select "Set Up Recurring Payments" or “Make One-Time Payment” from your Dashboard
Fill in the required fields to schedule your payment
Select "Confirm" on the Payment page

Question: What is an ABA routing number?
Answer: An ABA routing number (also known as a Routing Transit number) is an identification number, assigned to a financial institution and each branch office of that financial institution, which speeds up the processing of transfers between financial institutions.

Question: If I have multiple account holders in my family, can we each enroll in Pay Online?
Answer: Yes. Each account holder may set up a Recurring Payments Profile or make one-time payments. However, one account holder will not be able to view or use the other account holders banking information. In addition, each account holder can manage only the payments he or she has set up.

Question: Why cant I select some of the dates on the calendar when I am scheduling a payment?
Answer:
Recurring payments cannot be scheduled for the 29th, 30th, or 31st of the month.
One-time payments cannot be scheduled for weekends, bank holidays, or further than 60 days in advance.

Question: Can I make more than one payment in a month?
Answer: You can schedule as many one-time payments as youd like, as often as youd like.

Question: When does my same-day payment update to pending status?
Answer: Your same-day payment changes to Pending at 5:00 p.m. PST. Once your payment changes to Pending status, you will not be able to change the payment information.

Question: How do I remove a bank account and what will happen if I do?
Answer:
Log in to the website
Select “Menu” from the top navigation bar
Select “Manage Bank Accounts” under Payments
Select “Delete” next to the applicable bank account
A “Delete Bank” window will pop up
Click the “Delete” button
The bank account information will be removed from the “Manage Bank Accounts” page

Question: What happens if my bank rejects a payment?
Answer: Payments may be returned by a financial institution for insufficient funds, closed accounts or other reasons. If a payment is returned, we may discontinue your participation in the Pay Online program. If this occurs, all scheduled payments, except those in Pending status, will be cancelled. If your bank rejects a payment, you are still obligated to make your payment on time and in the specified amount.

Question: How do I delete or cancel a payment and what if I am unable to?
Answer:
Log in to the website
Scroll down to Transactions and select “View All Transactions”
Select the “+” under Details
Select “Cancel Payment”

Question: I have set up my Recurring Payments profile. If I edit one payment, will it affect any future payments?
Answer: You have the option to edit one recurring payment or delete all future payments. When a single recurring payment status changes to Scheduled, you may edit or cancel a single payment. This will not impact your Recurring Payments Profile. Once the payment status changes to Processing, you are unable to edit or cancel the payment.

Question: Will the recurring payments I scheduled on the TFS website automatically stop at the end of my finance or lease contract?
Answer: Yes. However, if your next payment is in Processing status when your account is closed or if a payment is scheduled to occur before the payoff has been fully processed, that payment may be processed. If the payment does get processed, you will be entitled to a refund if your account has been overpaid. For this reason, we recommend that you cancel your any scheduled payments after you pay off your account. Note: If you have obtained a lease maturity extension, you may need to set up recurring payments through that period.

Question: What types of payment notifications will I receive?

Question: What are marketing preferences? Are they different from notifications?
Answer: Marketing preferences give you a chance to pick the channel where youd prefer to receive marketing communications, which can include product news and information, updates on model launches, and invitations to exclusive events from TFS. Question: How do I download the Toyota Financial Services mobile app?
Answer: The mobile app is available for download through the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mytfs-toyota-financial-services/id472110881) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?idcom.tmcc.click2pay.mytfs). Note: As we enhance the app, we will periodically release updates. Please refer to your application notifications either from iTunes or Google updates.

Question: Are there fees to use the mobile app?
Answer: There is no charge to download or use the mobile app. However, you should contact your wireless service provider to see if any connectivity or usage rates may apply.

Question: What security measures help protect my transactions through the mobile app?
Answer: Our 128-bit SSL encryption technology safeguards traffic for secure web applications and helps protects your information as it travels from your mobile device to us.

Question: How can I be sure the mobile app information is secure if my mobile device is lost or stolen?
Answer: You are required to enter a valid Username and Password to access your account information from the mobile app. If your mobile device is lost or stolen, no one can access your account without your login credentials.

Question: What is fingerprint authentication?
Answer: Fingerprint authentication lets you log in to the myTFS app with your fingerprint in place of your username and password.  Touch ID is fingerprint authentication technology for Apple mobile devices.  Fingerprint is fingerprint authentication technology for Android mobile devices.

Question: What are the benefits of using fingerprint authentication?
Answer: Quick and convenient to authenticate your identity  No typing long passwords on your mobile device  No more forgetting or resetting your password  Your fingerprint is unique and impossible to guess or replicate  Simplifies account recovery

Question: Is there fee for using fingerprint authentication?
Answer: No. Fingerprint authentication is free to TFS account holders with mobile devices.

Question: Which devices are compatible with fingerprint authentication?
Answer: For Touch ID, Apple mobile device with iOS 6.0 or higher with Touch ID functionality For Fingerprint, Android mobile device with OS 7.0 or higher with Fingerprint functionality

Question: How do I add a fingerprint to my mobile device?
Answer: Visit your device settings and select Touch ID Settings (from an Apple mobile device) or Lock Screen and Security (from an Android mobile device). From there, follow the steps to register one or more fingerprints on your device.

Question: Where is my fingerprint stored?
Answer: Your device stores the information needed to recognize your fingerprint. The myTFS app utilizes the devices functionality to recognize your fingerprint when you log in. TFS does not store your fingerprint in any way.

Question: What account features are available on the mobile app?
Answer: You are able to do the following:  Make a payment  View edit app payments  View payoff contract information  View Account History  Retrieve contact information

Question: Once I have my fingerprint set up on my mobile device, how do I enable fingerprint authentication from the login page of the myTFS app?

Agree to the Electronic Communications Agreements and Mobile Application Polices and Agreements e.Select Enable to activate fingerprint authentication f.Update your Security Question and Answer g.Select if you would like the Security Question to be presented with every login h.Select Finish to complete enrollment

Question: How do I enable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?
Answer: Follow these steps to enable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings: a. Log in to the myTFS app with your username and password b.Select More from the Home / My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle the Touch ID or Fingerprint switch On e.Select Continue to go to the Login page f.Enter your username, password and select the box next to Enable Touch ID or Enable Fingerprint g.Select Login h.Enter the Answer to the Security Question i.Select if the device is Personal or Shared, then select Continue j. Question: How to do I disable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?
Answer: Follow these steps to disable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings: a.Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home / My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle the Touch ID or Fingerprint switch Off e.Confirmation pop up is presented f.Select Continue to turn disable fingerprint authentication

Question: Once fingerprint authentication is enabled and set up on the myTFS app, how do I log in to my TFS account using fingerprint authentication?
Answer: Follow these steps to log in to your TFS account using fingerprint authentication: a.Open the myTFS app b. You will be prompted to scan your fingerprint to log in by placing your finger on the device touchpad ( Home button) c.If challenged with a Security Question, enter the Answer d.Select Continue to complete login

Question: Can I use different fingerprints to log in?
Answer: Yes. You can log in using any fingerprint registered on your device.

Question: Should I use fingerprint authentication if I share my device with others?
Answer: No. When you log in with Touch ID or Fingerprint enabled, anyone with a registered fingerprint on your device can log into your TFS account. We highly recommend you do not enable Touch ID or Fingerprint if you share your device.

Question: What should I do if my device is lost or stolen?
Answer: You should contact your mobile carrier first, then contact our [Customer Service Center](#) and let us know that you device has been lost or stolen. We can disable the login feature within the fingerprint authentication feature on the myTFS app. If you have the Find My iPhone app on your Apple mobile device, or the Find My Device app on your Android mobile device, you can lock your device and keep your information safe. Contact Apple or Google for more information.

Question: Once I have enrolled in Touch ID or Fingerprint, can I still log in to my account with my username and password?
Answer: Yes. You can log in to your account with your username and password any time. When you open the myTFS app and prompted to scan your fingerprint, select Cancel to return to the Login page where you can enter your username and password.

Question: What happens if I change a fingerprint stored on my phone?
Answer: If a change to the fingerprint registry is detected on your device, fingerprint authentication will be disabled. You will have to add a new fingerprint to reactivate fingerprint authentication on your device.

Question: How do I enable additional security from Security Settings?
Answer: Follow these steps to enable additional security from Security Settings on your mobile device: a. Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home/My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle switch On or Off to have your security question presented every time you login e.Select a Security Question f.Enter the Answer to the Security Question g.Select Continue h.Receive a confirmation pop-up i.Select OK

Question: How do I start using the mobile app?
Answer: If you have registered for account access from our website, use your login credentials to use the app. If you have not yet registered on the website, launch the app and select Register from the opening screen.

Question: How do I disable additional security?
Answer: Follow these steps to disable additional security from Security Settings: a.Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home/My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle switch On or Off to have their security question presented during Fingerprint authentication login e.Receive a confirmation pop-up f.Select Confirm to disable fingerprint authentication two-step verification

Question: How can I make a principal-only payment on the Mobile App?

Question: Do I have to be registered from your website to use the mobile app?
Answer: No. You can register on the app. To use the app, you will be required to accept the Online Policies Agreements for Mobile Device Applications.

Question: Will I be able to access my account from the mobile app without username and password?
Answer: No. To help protect your data, we require customers to enter a valid Username and Password to access the secure account section.

Question: Will my Username and Password from your website work on the mobile app?
Answer: Yes. You will be able to access your account from the app using the same login credentials from our website. To use the app, you will be required to accept the Online Policies Agreements for Mobile Device Applications.

Question: If I registered from the mobile app, will the login credentials work on your website?
Answer: Yes, The login credentials can be used from either the mobile app or website. If you registered from the app and login for the first time to our website, you will be required to accept the Online Policies Agreements for website.

Question: After how many incorrect login attempts will the mobile app be locked?
Answer: After your fifth invalid login attempt, your access to the mobile app will be locked. From the login screen, use the self-service tools such as Forgot Password and Forgot Username to reset your login credentials.

Question: Will my session time out while using the mobile app?
Answer: Yes. To help protect your data, the mobile app session will time out after 5 minutes. To avoid time out, ensure you are active in the session after you login.

Question: If I apply for credit, am I obligated to finance or lease a vehicle through TFS?
Answer: No, the online credit application is a tool to help you shop for your vehicle and creates no obligation to finance or lease a vehicle from TFS or from the dealer you select during the process.

Question: Do I have to go to the dealer on my online credit application?
Answer: No. If you are pre-approved for a finance or lease contract, you will receive a pre-approval certificate (via email) that you can use at any participating Toyota dealer. If you use this certificate at a dealer other than the one listed on your online credit application, you are applying for credit at that dealership and may need to provide additional information.

Question: How secure is the online credit form?
Answer: As a financial services company, TFS works hard to protect your privacy and security. We have adopted technology and security standards widely used throughout the online banking industry. When you submit your credit application or access your account information, your data is encrypted for further security. Please read our [Privacy Policy](/us/en/online_policies_and_agreements.html) for more information.

Question: Im not comfortable applying for credit online. Are there other ways I can apply?
Answer: Yes. If you would rather not apply online, simply [download the application](/content/dam/tmcc-webcommons/toyotafinancial/documents/planning_tools/FAQS/F0300.pdf), fill it out, then fax or take a hard copy with you to your local Toyota dealer. Note : To view and print this PDF document, you need to install the free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC on to your computer.

Question: Why cant I use the online credit application?
Answer: If you entered your ZIP code and got a message that you were out of our serviced area, that means that the dealers in your area dont take online applications. Instead, you can simply print out the [application form](/content/dam/tmcc-webcommons/toyotafinancial/documents/financing_options/for_businesses/business_credit_application/TFSBusinessSolutionsCreditApp.pdf), fill it out and take a hard copy in to your local dealer.

Question: Will a credit check be run on my co-applicant?
Answer: Yes. Since your co-applicant is applying to be the co-buyer or lessee on your finance or lease contract, we need to run a credit report for you and your co-applicant.

Question: Why do you need my zip code? Can I change it after submitting my application?
Answer: We ask for your ZIP code to determine if you are in an area where the local dealers accept online credit applications. Because vehicle option combinations vary by region, your ZIP code also helps us more accurately estimate the amount youll need to finance or lease a vehicle in your area. We remember your ZIP code to help create a personalized experience, allowing us to provide accurate information for your area of residence. The ZIP code you enter as part of the online credit application process is an example of this. To change to a different ZIP code, youll need to close and re-launch your Internet browser to begin a new session.

Question: Why does the form repeatedly return me to the zip code entry screen?
Answer: Your browser settings need to accept cookies for all of the features of the online credit application to work correctly. Cookies allow us to receive and store information when your browser accesses our website. If your browser settings are not set to accept cookies, you will not be able to complete the online credit application process. If youd like to enable cookies within your browser, refer to the Help portion of your browsers toolbar.

Question: What happens if I leave my computer in the middle of the application process?
Answer: If you leave your computer for 5 minutes or more, your credit application session will time out. This security feature has been put in place to protect your personal information. Please note that if your session times out, the information you entered will be erased and youll need to begin the process again.

Question: The website and application list a Total SRP. How is the final sales price determined?
Answer: Total SRP is the Total Suggested Retail Price from the manufacturer. The final price will be agreed upon by you and the dealer.

Question: How is my annual percentage rate (APR) determined?
Answer: Your Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is agreed upon by you and your dealer. Take a look at [Understanding The Finance Charges](/content/dam/tmcc-webcommons/toyotafinancial/documents/financing_options/buy_a_toyota/TFS_simple_interest.pdf) to see how your interest is calculated. Note: To view this PDF document, you need to install the [free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC](https://get.adobe.com/reader/) on to your computer.

Question: What happens after my application is received?
Answer: After you submit your application, our credit analysts review it and make a decision. If you are approved, we notify you via email within one business day. The email has a pre-approval certificate embedded in it that is valid for 30 days from the date it was issued. You can use it at the Toyota dealer of your choice or at any participating Toyota dealer. Your selected dealer may also contact you to schedule an appointment to discuss your financing needs. In some cases, TFS and your dealer may need more time to finalize a credit decision. If you are not approved within one business day, your dealer may contact you with details on the status of your application. You should receive a final credit decision from us within three business days.

Question: What are my options if my application is not approved?
Answer: You can contact your selected dealer (or any participating dealer) for more information and your options. You will also receive a letter from TFS explaining our credit decision and your rights.

Question: I was approved with modified terms. How do I find out what the original terms were?
Answer: You can contact your selected dealer (or any participating dealer) to discuss the details of your original terms and your modified approval.

Question: Where can I find my pre-approval certificate?
Answer: The pre-approval certificate is embedded in the body of the approval email, instead of being sent as a separate attachment. Print and take the email with you to your dealer. If you applied with a co-applicant, only the primary applicant will receive a pre-approval certificate.

Question: What is Paperless?

Question: What payment methods do you offer? Can I pay with cash, credit, or debit card?
Answer: Unfortunately, we cant process cash, credit, or debit card payments. Since cash is not an accepted payment method, we reserve the right to not process a payment provided in cash and return the cash to the sender by regular mail. However, we do offer several other options to help you keep your account up to date: Pay Online - This flexible, convenient and secure service allows you to schedule a one-time or recurring payment on our website or mobile app and avoid writing monthly checks. AutoCheque - We can automatically debit your monthly vehicle payment from your bank account. Simply download, print, complete and submit an [AutoCheque form](/content/dam/tmcc-webcommons/toyotafinancial/documents/planning_tools/ways_to_pay/TFS_Auto_Cheque_Form.pdf) (in PDF format) and well get you started. To view this PDF document, you need to install the free [Adobe Acrobat Reader DC](https://get.adobe.com/reader/) on to your computer. Pay by Mail - If youre not sure where to send your payment, log in to your account to see the current mailing address. Pay by Phone - You can make a payment from your checking account 24 hours a day by calling 1-(800)-874-8822 for our Customer Service Team. Please have your routing and bank account numbers available when you call.

Question: How can I set up automatic payments?
Answer:
Log in to the website
Select "Set Up Recurring Payments" or “Make One-Time Payment” from your Dashboard
Fill in the required fields to schedule your payment
Select "Confirm" on the Payment page

Question: How long does it take for AutoCheque to begin debiting from my account and when will my AutoCheque payment come out?
Answer: After receiving your completed and signed form, we will process your enrollment request. Enrollment is generally completed within 14 business days. Continue making your regularly scheduled payments. You will receive an AutoCheque enrollment confirmation notice identifying the first automatic withdrawal date and amount.

Question: How can I pay toward Principal Reduction?
Answer: Amounts in excess of the total amount due are applied to the unpaid principal and will be applied toward your next scheduled payment. Depending on the amount, your account may be considered paid ahead. Daily interest continues to accrue on your unpaid principal balance. Follow these steps to make a principal-only payment: Website : From the Make One-Time Payment page, select Make A Principal Only Payment. Your account must be current. App : From the Dashboard or Make One-Time Payment page, select Make A Principal Only Payment. Your account must be current. Mail : Include your account number and Principal Only on the memo line of the check and mail to: Toyota Financial Services PO Box 4700 Phoeniz, AZ 85030 Phone : Speak to a Team Member or use our automated system at 1-(800)-874-8822 Puerto Rico Customers: Please send payment(s) PO Box 366251, San Juan, P.R. 00936-6252 Note: Principal-only payments will reduce your unpaid principal balance only and will not be applied toward past-due amounts or payments that are currently due or will become due in the future. You remain responsible for making timely payments as they become due. You can make a principal-only payment via any of our automated systems every 24 hours. Additional principal-only payments may be made with an agent.

Question: Will I be charged a late fee if my payment is not received by the due date?
Answer: Late fees are subject to state laws. Please review your contract or billing statement for account specific details. Question: What are my options for receiving my Privacy Policy and will I need to update my choice each year? After I have made a choice, can I change it later?
Answer: We provide you with the most up-to-date version of your Privacy Policy on an annual basis either by mail or electronically. On the TFS website, you can choose how youd like to receive your Privacy Policy. You wont need to update your choice each year, it will remain in effect until it is changed or revoked by you. You can change your choice on the TFS website at any time. However, please be aware that choices made within a short time period prior to the annual mailing may not go into effect at the time of mailing. We will post on the TFS website the final day that changes may be made, which will affect your current annual mailings.

Question: What happens if I dont make a choice?
Answer: If no choice is made, you will receive your Privacy Policy by mail. Additionally, youll be able to view your Privacy Policy on the TFS website at any time as long as you are a registered user. If you choose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically, you will no longer receive a copy in the mail and will get an email notification informing you that a new Privacy Policy is ready to view on the TFS website. Note: California customers will receive an email with the Privacy Policy as an attachment.

Question: Will I be able to view the most recent version of the Privacy Policy on the TFS website?
Answer: Yes. All customers who are registered on the TFS website can view their most recent Privacy Policy online. If you choose to receive the Privacy Policy only electronically, we will no longer mail you a copy.

Question: If I already opted in for paperless billing, does that mean I will also receive my Privacy Policy electronically?
Answer: No. Opting in for paperless billing does not apply to the Privacy Policy. You need to take an additional step to choose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically.

Question: Why are there other documents listed along with the Privacy Policy that I can choose to receive only electronically? Can I choose to receive some documents electronically and others by paper?
Answer: On an annual basis, TFS provides you with your Privacy Policy, a Legal Servicing Notice, and our Pay by Phone Error Resolution Notice. For each document type listed, you can choose how they are received. You may choose to receive all of them electronically, by mail, or a combination of both.

Question: Will I be charged a fee if I chose to receive my privacy policy only electronically?
Answer: No. There is no fee associated your preference for how you wish to receive your Privacy Policy or any other TFS account-related document.

Question: Is the distribution of the Privacy Policy the only instance in which I will receive my Privacy Policy electronically?
Answer: No. If you move from one state to another and notify us with your new address, you may receive a new Privacy Policy due to state-specific content.

Question: If I chose to receive my Privacy Policy only electronically, why am I still receiving a paper notice at my mailing address?
Answer: If you chose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically, but the email we send to notify you is unable to be delivered, we will mail it to ensure that you receive a copy. Also, in some cases involving multiple account holders, if one chooses to receive their notice electronically, while others do not, a notice may be mailed.

Question: What is usage-based insurance?
Answer: Usage-based insurance or UBI, is a way for you to opt-in to share your driving data and, based on how you and your family drive, potentially save money on an auto insurance policy. Visit https://toyotainsurance.com

Question: What data is shared for usage-based insurance?
Answer: With your consent, your modern car, truck, or SUV collects input from your vehicle every time you drive. Hundreds of sensors in the vehicle monitor data points including speed, braking, acceleration, driving time, steering, safety system activation, and even when your vehicle needs its next maintenance. Modern vehicles are equipped with a device called a Data Communication Module (DCM) that transmits telematics data every single second. Anti-lock braking systems (ABS), traction control, adaptive cruise control, all need to collect feedback from dozens of vehicle systems so that you can use them when you drive. Visit https://toyotainsurance.com

Question: What are Voluntary Protection Products?
Answer: Voluntary Protection Products are optional vehicle protection plans designed to help protect your investment and provide peace of mind against unexpected issues. Vehicle Service Agreements, Prepaid Maintenance, Guaranteed Auto Protection, Tire Wheel Protection, Key Replacement, and Excess Wear Use Protection are examples of Voluntary Protection Products. A Voluntary Protection Product is a product or service offered to vehicle buyers that is sold above and beyond the vehicle price. The purchase of a Voluntary Protection Product is optional, cancelable (subject to specific agreement terms) and not required to obtain credit.

Question: Whats considered excessive wear and use?
Answer: Any damage that is beyond normal wear and tear is considered excessive. Some examples might include tears or burns on upholstery, missing or broken equipment or large dents or scratches on the exterior of the vehicle. If it helps to see some examples of whats considered excessive, check out our [Wear and Use Guidelines](https://www.toyotafinancial.com/content/dam/nextgen-shared/lease-end/TFS_lease-end_guide.pdf). We also recommend reviewing your lease agreement as it includes additional excess wear and use information specific to your vehicle. Just a heads up, though, the examples provided may not include all instances of excessive damage that could subject you to additional charges based on the terms of your lease agreement.

Question: Can I make repairs to my leased vehicle so I dont incur wear and use charges?
Answer: Of course. In fact, we encourage you to schedule a complimentary inspection and to review the [Wear and Use Guidelines](https://toyotafinancial.com/pub/static/lease_end/wear---use.html) to see whether your vehicle has wear and use that is considered excessive. If repair work is needed and youd like to make repairs prior to turning in the vehicle, your local Toyota dealer is a great option to assist you. Be sure to keep all of your receipts for repairs made and review your insurance policy to see if any items may be covered. If your damages exceeding normal wear and use arent repaired, it can result in charges at lease termination. 1 All charges may be subject to sales tax.

Question: Can I claim a tax deduction on the interest paid for my car loan?
Answer:
Recent legislation allows certain individuals to claim a tax deduction on interest paid for personal-use car loans from 2025 through 2028. Eligibility depends on your individual circumstances, such as your income and whether the vehicle is used for personal purposes. It is important to note that tax laws can change, and it is your responsibility to determine if you qualify for this deduction. We recommend consulting a qualified tax advisor to understand how this applies to your specific situation. For more detailed information, please refer to the IRS guidance ( [One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act: Tax deductions for working Americans and seniors | Internal Revenue Service](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/one-big-beautiful-bill-act-tax-deductions-for-working-americans-and-seniors)).
Car loan interest may also be deductible in certain situations where you use your vehicle for your business or self-employment. Consult a tax advisor to understand how this applies to your specific situation.

Interest only accrues on retail loans (not lease accounts), you may request  interest paid for a previous year, please contact us at (800-874-8822).
